title: xongoloola xaqut tan leeh
intro: taswiir ayyunti migaq magaala hinnay amoytiinu, takkay immay uxih lee dariifal mano gaaboysen. dubuk dago ayat kassittam ta ayyunta, umman way too miracsenta cinna marih fanat roorimte. oson qidiinok yaabanam ankacis.
clues: Nanu Qur'aanak migaq le ayyunta kinnino, uxih ni aydaadi inkih cuumih addat raaqeh yan.
Nanu umman way Ad kee Samuud ummattah innah, diggalsimeh yan marih xaqut galab kak xaggiime.
Nanu Ar-Rass Sahaaba deqsitta, ni mano edde axawah sugte qeeli.
Qado miracsenta luk nee fan ruube farmoyta dirabne.
Yalli rubte farmoytit inkih cinee marat loowimenno.
Nanu foocal bohoy kibbiimeh qagitak kulli ganak foocal nek, finqa ni cineh.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
